stages.name: Lingering Illness
stages.description: Waking with a start on a rainy night, old wounds aching.

stages.name: Silent Raindrops
stages.description: The rain has gone on for too long. So long that we could no longer tell truth from lies. So long that we could not see who has walked into the rain.

stages.name: Eye for an Eye
stages.description: If someone spits at you, spit back on their face. — Siracusan saying < Blood Ledger > All enemies are boosted and Famiglia Silencer is summoned when Blood Debt is at max. < Defensive Rune > Operators deployed on it have increased DEF.

stages.name: The Honorable
stages.description: " Signora Sicilia be my witness, I shall give glory unto my famiglia, never to deceive or betray it." < Blood Ledger > All enemies are boosted and Famiglia Silencer is summoned when Blood Debt is at max.

stages.name: Prime Target
stages.description: To change the absurdity of reality, one must be prepared to make an enemy of the world. < Blood Ledger > All enemies are boosted and Famiglia Silencer is summoned when Blood Debt is at max.

stages.name: Crack of Thunder
stages.description: There are two eternal truths under this sky: order and violence. < Blood Ledger > All enemies are boosted and Famiglia Silencer is summoned when Blood Debt is at max.

stages.name: Cut Open
stages.description: Truth is revealed from the depths of blood and flesh.

stages.name: Old Rules
stages.description: Old laws cannot be shaken without the courage to abandon and sacrifice. < Blood Ledger > All enemies are boosted and Famiglia Silencer is summoned when Blood Debt is at max.

stages.name: Old Conflicts
stages.description: Stand and face the wheels of old, or be run over by them. < Blood Ledger > All enemies are boosted and Famiglia Silencer is summoned when Blood Debt is at max.

stages.name: What to be Forgotten
stages.description: Our memories keep us alive and torment us. < Blood Ledger > All enemies are boosted and Famiglia Silencer is summoned when Blood Debt is at max.

stages.name: Walking on Eggshells
stages.description: You should have picked up the first fowlbeast egg when it appeared. < Blood Ledger > All enemies are boosted and Famiglia Silencer is summoned when Blood Debt is at max.

stages.name: Troublemaker
stages.description: Pain is inevitable when you reach the roots.

stages.name: Lies of Civilization
stages.description: Lock and load. The gun can be an instrument of order, or destroy the facade of civilization. < Blood Ledger > All enemies are boosted and Famiglia Silencer is summoned when Blood Debt is at max.

stages.name: Signore dei Lupi
stages.description: Wolf of the wild , what has becometh of thee? < Blood Ledger > All enemies are boosted and Famiglia Silencer is summoned when Blood Debt is at max.

stages.name: Sew Together
stages.description: A cut to fester, or a cut to heal?

stages.name: Muffling Drizzles
stages.description: The rain washes away all, drowns all, and says nothing. < Blood Ledger > All enemies are boosted and Famiglia Shadow Silencer is summoned when Blood Debt is at max. < Active Originium > Operators deployed on it and enemies who have passed it will take constant damage, but their ATK and Attack Speed will be increased significantly.

stages.name: Rainy Days
stages.description: The rain forms a fine net that catches all souls on this earth. < Blood Ledger > All enemies are boosted and Famiglia Shadow Silencer is summoned when Blood Debt is at max.

stages.name: Storm Brewing
stages.description: A heavy drop of rain falls on the window, the sign of the coming storm. < Blood Ledger > All enemies are boosted and Famiglia Shadow Silencer is summoned when Blood Debt is at max.

stages.name: Dark Skies
stages.description: Some take shelter under a roof, some hold up their umbrellas, and some carry on despite being battered. < Blood Ledger > All enemies are boosted and Famiglia Shadow Silencer is summoned when Blood Debt is at max.

stages.name: Precautionary Measures
stages.description: You know the rain is coming. You know what to prepare for. < Blood Ledger > All enemies are boosted and Famiglia Shadow Silencer is summoned when Blood Debt is at max.

stages.name: From Rain to Frost
stages.description: Suffering is not to be praised, but it creates the strongest ties. < Blood Ledger > All enemies are boosted and Famiglia Shadow Silencer is summoned when Blood Debt is at max.

stages.name: Dripping Rain
stages.description: Wear your sleeping mask and listen to the rain knock on the glass windows as you futilely try to sleep. < Blood Ledger > All enemies are boosted and Famiglia Shadow Silencer is summoned when Blood Debt is at max.

stages.name: Broken Rain
stages.description: Break the arrogant hair. The rain has gone on long enough. < Blood Ledger > All enemies are boosted and Famiglia Shadow Silencer is summoned when Blood Debt is at max.

stages.name: Murder
stages.description: Defend the famiglia's honor at all costs. < Blood Ledger > All enemies are boosted and Famiglia Shadow Silencer is summoned when Blood Debt is at max. Condition : More Famiglia Shadow Silencers may appear during Asset Liquidation, taking different routes each time.

stages.name: Manipulate
stages.description: The famiglia's will shall be done. < Blood Ledger > All enemies are boosted and Famiglia Shadow Silencer is summoned when Blood Debt is at max. Condition : Father Agenir 's bullets have 2x DEF reduction effect. No melee/ranged deployment restrictions.

stages.name: Vengeance
stages.description: The famiglia's wrongs shall be avenged. < Blood Ledger > All enemies are boosted and Famiglia Shadow Silencer is summoned when Blood Debt is at max. Condition : Enemies have greatly increased Max HP and DEF.

stages.name: Bounty
stages.description: The famiglia's order permits no challenge. < Blood Ledger > All enemies are boosted and Famiglia Shadow Silencer is summoned when Blood Debt is at max. Condition : Enemies have greatly increased Max HP, ATK, and DEF.

stages.name: Repentance
stages.description: Swallow the bread and let rain wash away your sins. Pray that the sun's rays await at the end of the rainy season. < Blood Ledger > All enemies are boosted and Famiglia Shadow Silencer is summoned when Blood Debt is at max. Condition : Signore dei Lupi DEF increased.
